Stage A · rig identification

Robust (Student-t) likelihood in friction space, equal weight per load, Sobol multi-start (24 starts) and full-batch L-BFGS. The data term is tempered by the AR(1) variance inflation factor 37.6 (effective sample size 175 of 6582 rows), so the uncertainties below are not over-confident.

Stage B · track calibration (errors-in-variables)

140 quasi-steady 1.0-s segments from 5 runs. Each segment carries a latent sideslip (global + run + segment terms with measurement priors σ = 1.5°/1.5°/2.0°); grip is scaled the MF6.2 way (LMUY on friction, LKY on stiffness – fixed at 1).
